critical_code_review_comments: buyer_shipment_items must always be seeded with po_item_id for post_revenue_on_buyer_dispatch to resolve selling_price_snapshot (engine keys on it.po_item_id → po_items.id). This is the only lookup — no fallback to (po_id, sku); consider a safety fallback for legacy/unseeded rows.
Manual journal endpoint uses body key 'date' (not 'entry_date'). Docs across tests/prompts sometimes call it entry_date; align naming to avoid confusion.
Period documents key field is 'period_code' (not 'period_key'). Same alignment note as above.

ensure-year is idempotent w.r.t. period creation only if the year has no rows at all; if rows exist even as closed, it returns created:0 and does not reopen them. Behaviour is correct but worth documenting so alerts+re-open flow is understood.
